editorial:
Imagine going through a rough breakup and suddenly realizing you cannot afford your own place. That is exactly where you find Faith, a woman just trying to get her life back together. She puts out an ad for a roommate, and while the new tenant seems perfect at first, things quickly start to feel off. You will feel that creeping sense of dread as the new girl begins to overstep boundaries and act strange. It is a classic setup that makes you question how well you really know the people you let into your home, creating a tense mood that keeps you glued to your seat.

The acting is solid and makes the danger feel real, though the story follows some familiar paths you might have seen in other thrillers. The best part is how the tension builds up slowly until the big reveal. If you love movies about secret identities and dangerous strangers, you should definitely check this one out.
endingExplained: You find out the roommate is actually a dangerous predator who targets vulnerable women. She tries to take over Faith's entire life by pushing her out and stealing her identity. In the final showdown, Faith manages to fight back and outsmart her. After a scary struggle, the police arrive just in time to arrest the roommate. Faith finally gets her home back and learns a hard lesson about trusting strangers too quickly.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological thrillers and stories about dangerous roommates.
